onboarding.lang.time: About 100 minutes in total. You can pause at any time and resume on any device.

onboarding.sponsor.welcome.1: {organisation, select, none {Welcome. I am glad you are here.} other {Welcome to {organisation}. I am glad you are here.}}
onboarding.sponsor.welcome.2: You are taking over a team of {size} across our sales funnel, from first call to signed deal. Some are thriving, some are new, and one or two are struggling.
onboarding.sponsor.welcome.3: I care about two things: the number, and whether the team is stronger when you leave than when you arrived.
onboarding.sponsor.product.1: Deals move through {count} stages: {stages}. Each stage hands its deals to the next, so one weak stage slows everything after it.
onboarding.sponsor.product.2: Every stage needs someone in it, and at most {max, plural, one {one person} other {{maxWords} people}} can work a stage at once.
onboarding.sponsor.targets.2: Keep Team Morale and Trust healthy. A burned out team will not hold the number next quarter.
onboarding.sponsor.targets.3: You have {amount} of your own time each {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}. Spend them well.
onboarding.consent.title: Before you start, here is what we record

onboarding.consent.detail: {item, select, what {Your typed replies and, if you use voice, transcripts of what you say. Audio itself is not kept.} why {AI reads your words to decide how each person reacts, and to write your development report.} keep {Kept for 12 months, then deleted. Never your real colleagues.}}}}
onboarding.consent.note: If you choose text only, you can play the whole simulation and turn voice on later in Settings.
onboarding.textOnly.toast: Text only it is. You can turn voice on any time in Settings.

onboarding.voice.unavailable.title: No microphone we can use
onboarding.voice.unavailable.body: We could not find a microphone, or this browser cannot record. Carry on in text, nothing is lost. You can turn voice on later in Settings.
onboarding.voice.heardNothing: Nothing heard yet. Press the mic and read the line aloud.
onboarding.voice.status: {state, select, listening {Listening. Read the line aloud.} finishing {Writing down what you said} silent {We did not hear anything. Check your mic is on and try again.} other {}}
onboarding.voice.sampleLine: Hi, good to meet you. I am glad you are here, and I want to hear how this week is going.
onboarding.voice.denied.title: Your browser blocked the microphone
onboarding.voice.denied.body: Click the lock icon in the address bar, set Microphone to Allow, then try again. Or carry on in text, nothing is lost.
onboarding.voice.mic: {listening, select, yes {Stop listening} other {Start mic test}}
onboarding.voice.phrase: I'm ready to lead my team.
onboarding.voice.sampleToast: {name}: “Hi, good to meet you.” Captions on.
onboarding.how.title: How to play
onboarding.how.card: {card, select, loop {The weekly loop} kinds {Quick or live} clock {The clock} other {How you are evaluated}}
onboarding.how.loop: Each {unit, select, year {year} month {month} week {week} day {day} other {period}}, set a style for each person, spend your {amount} on actions, then see how the team responds.
onboarding.how.kinds: Some actions are instant decisions. Live ones open a real conversation you have by voice or text.
onboarding.how.clock: The clock is there to help you pace yourself. It pauses during conversations and whenever you pause.
onboarding.how.evaluated: Results matter, and so does how you got there. Your report shows what you did well and what to try next.
